description: This file implements IDNA2008 domain name processing, including functions for converting domain names to ASCII and Unicode, validation, normalization, and label validation according to RFC 5890, RFC 5891, and related standards. It defines profiles for different use cases such as lookup, display, and registration, and includes detailed label validation logic.

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: Configuration object for IDNA processing, including validation and mapping options.

classes.name: labelError
classes.description: Error type for invalid domain name labels.

methods.name: ToASCII
methods.description: Converts a domain name to its ASCII form, handling normalization and validation.

methods.name: ToUnicode
methods.description: Converts a domain name from ASCII to Unicode form.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string describing the profile configuration.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Implements the core IDNA processing algorithm as per UTS #46.

methods.name: validateLabel
methods.description: Validates individual domain name labels according to RFC rules.

methods.name: simplify
methods.description: Simplifies label categories based on profile options.
